questions.prompt: What is the output of `$i = 5; do { $i; $i++ } while ($i -lt 3)`?

options.a: 5 (runs once because condition is tested after execution)
options.b: Nothing is output because 5 is not less than 3

questions.prompt: What is the key difference between the `foreach` statement (`foreach ($x in $col)`) and the `ForEach-Object` cmdlet?

options.a: The statement iterates an in-memory collection; the cmdlet streams pipeline input and binds $_
options.c: The cmdlet works only on numbers, while the statement works only on strings
